o: the appearance of stale, soapy or painty odours from oxidation of lipids or from lipase action
the anaerobic decomposition of protein yielding foul-smelling nitrogenous compounds
deterioration that renders a product unfit for human consumption
an organism able to grow where no free oxygen is present
items.s: Spoilage: deterioration that renders a product unfit for human consumption. The other options describe Rancidity, Anaerobe, Putrefaction.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “sealing a product with the air drawn out so that the film clings tightly to it”
o: Vacuum packing
Aseptic filling
Cold store
Active packaging
items.s: Vacuum packing is sealing a product with the air drawn out so that the film clings tightly to it.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the appearance of stale, soapy or painty odours from oxidation of lipids or from lipase action”
o: Spoilage
Histamine
Rancidity
Putrefaction
items.s: Rancidity is the appearance of stale, soapy or painty odours from oxidation of lipids or from lipase action.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Lactic fermentation.
o: a soft seasoned mass made by grinding cured or fermented material
the material carrying the microbes deliberately introduced to start a controlled change
the souring of minced material by bacteria that turn sugar into acid
a preparation of selected microbes added to direct a change in a predictable way
items.s: Lactic fermentation: the souring of minced material by bacteria that turn sugar into acid. The other options describe Fish paste, Inoculum, Starter culture.

items.q: The correct meaning of Hot smoking is
o: a treatment in which the heat of the vapour also cooks the product
a carcinogenic group of fused-ring compounds formed when wood burns incompletely
a class of ring compounds in wood vapour that act as antioxidants and antimicrobials
a condensate of vapour from smouldering wood applied by dipping or spraying
items.s: Hot smoking: a treatment in which the heat of the vapour also cooks the product. The other options describe Phenol, Liquid smoke, Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon.

items.q: “the breakdown of carbohydrates by microbes into acids, gases or alcohol” is the definition of
o: Fish paste
Fermentation
Inoculum
Lactic fermentation
items.s: Fermentation is the breakdown of carbohydrates by microbes into acids, gases or alcohol.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the shrinking of a cell's contents away from its wall in a strong solution”
o: Curing
Plasmolysis
Pickling
Nitrite
items.s: Plasmolysis is the shrinking of a cell's contents away from its wall in a strong solution.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Autolysis.
o: the self-digestion of tissue by its own enzymes once the animal has died
the fall in tissue pH brought about by anaerobic breakdown of stored carbohydrate after death
the storage carbohydrate of muscle that is converted to a sour product after death
the stiffening of muscle that sets in after death when its energy reserves are exhausted
items.s: Autolysis: the self-digestion of tissue by its own enzymes once the animal has died. The other options describe Glycogen, Rigor mortis, Post-mortem acidification.
